question: Which concept is related to the disposal of the equity of public sector units in the market for covering the fiscal deficit of the central government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Disinvestment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Disinvestment** refers to the process of selling or liquidating an asset or subsidiary. In the context of public sector units (PSUs), it means the sale of government equity in PSUs.

• Disinvestment is carried out to reduce the fiscal burden on the government and to improve public finances.

• It helps in raising funds that can be utilized for various development projects or to cover the fiscal deficit.

• The process of disinvestment can also lead to better efficiency and management of the enterprises as it often brings in private players or investors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Denationalisation**:

• It refers to the process of transferring an industry or business from public to private ownership and control.

• It is often used interchangeably with privatization.

• **Liberalisation**:

• It refers to the relaxation of previous government restrictions, usually in areas of social, political, and economic policy.

• In the economic context, it means reducing government regulations and restrictions in an economy to encourage greater participation by private entities.

• **Globalisation**:

• It is the process of interaction and integration among people, companies, and governments worldwide.

• This process has effects on the environment, culture, political systems, economic development, and prosperity.
